description: This source file defines a custom exception class CenterNotFoundException used within the group management module of the Apache Fineract project. It inherits from AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException and provides constructors to handle cases when a group center with a specific ID is not found.

classes.name: CenterNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a specific group center resource was not found in the system.

methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception for an invalid center ID.
